title: A reply to a triaged mail goes to the sender's real address, though the model sees it as a placeholder

messages.subject: Room for your workshop on 14 March
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

We have two rooms free for your workshop on 14 March: the Garden Room (20 people, 180 EUR) or the Loft (35 people, 260 EUR). Could you tell us by Thursday which one you want? We release the hold after that.

Best,
Rowan Hart
Harbour Hall

steps.say: Answer Rowan that we'll take the Loft.

rubric: Does the proposed email tell Rowan that Sam takes the Loft for the workshop on 14 March?
